meta.title: Neural Glass · 神经流光
meta.description: Turns the Harness UI into a transparent glass workstation with a live Transformer animation behind it: one demo sentence is segmented into tokens, embedded, projected into Q / K / V, matched by attention arcs on three illustrative heads, passed through residual and normalization nodes, then propagated through 12 → 24 → 12 drawn MLP neurons and out as the next token. A compact background-density slider sits in the composer tool row beside the model selector, and its star button opens a floating Neural Glass panel (also reachable from the star at the sidebar foot): three moods (Focus / Balanced / Immersive), interface transparency, background glow, glass blur, animation speed, live-background and pause switches, intro fade, reset and a close button. Switch the skin on or off and tune the rest in Settings → Neural Glass: glass opacity, reading frost, brightness, speed, glow, particle density, code scan, module labels, Encoder–Decoder or Decoder-only structure, driver (built-in loop or live session activity), quality, pause, reduced motion, intro fade and reset. The dark base switch keeps the app on the dark theme while the skin is active and restores your previous theme preference when you turn the skin off. Colors carry fixed meaning (gold Q, teal K, coral V, ice-blue attention output, violet MLP activation, blue-grey static links). The animation is illustrative: segmentation, attention weights and MLP widths are demo data, not model telemetry. Transparency means the app's own panels show the canvas behind them; it does not make the OS window transparent. Wide layouts draw the MLP as 12 → 24 → 12 individual neurons; narrower windows draw fewer. To uninstall cleanly, switch the skin off first (that restores the original theme), then remove the bundle in Plugins. Disabling the skin removes the canvas, the glass layer and the theme override; settings are kept.
